channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Monrovia, Swytchback partner on garden center purchasing decisions webinar
item.description: Experts from both companies will share new data on how inventory mix, size assortment and perceived availability influence how shoppers buy.

item.title: Apply now for the Richard Foster Award
item.description: Students currently enrolled in a two- or four-year horticulture program are eligible to apply for this $2,500 scholarship.

item.title: Caterpillar names Shurman as construction industries president
item.description: Caterpillar veteran Rod Shurman's promotion is made effective Feb. 1, as Caterpillar's Tony Fassino becomes group president, retired, until May 31.

item.title: Ruppert Landscape adds new branch in Yorktown
item.description: The new branch will be led by Jeff Patch, who has been promoted to branch manager.

item.title: Greenzie declares winners for this year's Best of Greenzie Awards
item.description: The awards recognize organizations that use autonomy consistently in live commercial environments, and Yellowstone Landscape earned top marks.

item.title: Steel Green makes Opti-Rate standard on 2026 SGXL and SG54 machines
item.description: In addition to Opti-Rate becoming standard, all 2026 SGXL and SG54 machines also feature a new spray tank design.

item.title: Bgreen launches organic fluid Retain for cleaning shears and saws
item.description: Retain has been tested and certified organic by the Washington State Department of Agriculture.

item.title: Ignite Attachments debuts 60-, 72-inch pallet forks
item.description: The forks are engineered for heavy-duty and severe-duty frames and rated for 6,000 pounds.

item.title: Scott M. Asplundh dies at 68
item.description: The former chairman and CEO of Asplundh Tree Expert passed away last week due to complications with ALS.

item.title: AmericanHort accepting nominations for board of directors
item.description: Applications will be accepted between now and February 13.
